note: All 55 trophies are offline and single-player; no online trophies exist. Cheats disable trophies and saving, so keep them off for a trophy run.

PS.label: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

KG.label: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

EG.label: EGamers — GTA 6 Trophy List: All 55 Trophies

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: The first mission of the game. Play as Jason, follow the prompts through the fishing trip, and the trophy pops the moment the mission ends. There is nothing to prepare and nothing to miss — it is the opening beat of the story, and it unlocks on its own.
tips: Unmissable: it pops automatically as you play.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 1 and the trophy pops at the chapter card. Play at your own pace — chapter trophies cannot be missed, and free roam stays open after the finale, so nothing in the story can lock you out of the platinum.
tips: While you are in Chapter 1, do the one possibly missable thing in the game: meditate at Jason's house (see Positive Mental Attitude).

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Play through Chapter 2 to its end; the trophy pops at the chapter card. Like every chapter trophy it is unmissable, so just keep following the story missions as they appear on the map.
tips: Chapter trophies pop at the chapter card — no extra step needed.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 3 and the trophy pops at the chapter card. By this point the map has opened up considerably — use the downtime between missions to try activities and collectibles, since most of them count toward the later phases.
tips: A good moment to try each activity type once (see Master of None).

trophies.name: Top of the World, Ma
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 4 to pop this at the chapter card. It is the last chapter trophy before the finale, so once it pops you are one final mission away from the story's end — and from free roam, where the real cleanup begins.
tips: After this chapter, the 100% Completion checklist is nearly within reach.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Breakfast Run is a story mission that appears as you play through the early chapters. Take it when its marker shows on the map and finish it — the trophy pops at the mission's end. No preparation is needed; mission trophies unlock by playing the story.
tips: Mission trophies are unmissable.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: The Cartel Heist is a story heist mission. Follow the mission as directed — heists in this game are scripted set-pieces, so your job is to play through the beats until the getaway. The trophy pops when the mission completes.
tips: Stock up on armour and ammo before a heist mission; the game rarely lets you shop mid-mission.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Child's Play is a story mission on the critical path. Play it when it appears and finish it to pop the trophy. Like all story-mission trophies it cannot be missed — it is simply a matter of reaching it in the story.
tips: Mission trophies are unmissable.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Headliners is a story mission; complete it and the trophy pops. The name gives away nothing about how to play it — just follow the mission markers and objectives as they come, and the trophy follows.
tips: Mission trophies are unmissable.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: VCIA Takedown is a story mission set around Vice City International Airport. Play it through to the end and the trophy pops. Airport missions tend to be loud, so expect a wanted level on the way out and a fast vehicle waiting nearby.
tips: Keep a fast car or bike stashed near the airport for the getaway.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Operation Savage Glory is a story mission; finish it and the trophy pops. It is one of the later story missions, so by the time you reach it you will have the weapons and vehicles to handle it — just follow the objectives.
tips: Mission trophies are unmissable.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Finish the final story mission and this gold pops at the credits. It is the end of Phase 1 and the start of the real trophy hunt: after the credits, free roam stays open for as long as you like, the 100% Completion checklist unlocks, and everything you have not done yet can still be done — except the one possibly missable meditation spot from Chapter 1.
tips: After the finale, open Touch Pad > Progress > 100% Completion to see what the endgame asks of you.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.desc: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Work through Andy's mission strand whenever his icon appears on the map; the strand ends with his final mission, and the trophy pops when that mission completes. Stranger strands unlock as the story advances, so check the map after each chapter for new icons.
tips: Stranger missions are marked on the map — sweep them up between story chapters.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.desc: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete Kenton's strand, which ends with the mission Maritime Disputes. Kenton's missions involve boats, so keep a fast boat in mind when his missions start — the strand is short, and the trophy pops at the final mission's end.
tips: Final mission: Maritime Disputes.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.desc: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Finish Billy's strand, which ends with the mission Hometown Heroes. Billy's missions are biker-flavoured, so a good motorcycle helps; the trophy pops when the final mission completes.
tips: Final mission: Hometown Heroes.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.desc: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Randy's strand is built around his wish list of vehicles: find and deliver the vehicles he asks for, and the strand ends with his final mission. A guide to the wish-list vehicle locations is linked in the sources — check it before you start hunting, so you know what to look for.
tips: Randy's missions need specific vehicles; the cited guide lists where each one is.

trophies.name: Spin on This!
trophies.desc: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete Tyrone's strand to its final mission. His missions revolve around the Kitty Litter Labs, and the cited guide lists every lab location — use it to plan your route instead of wandering. The trophy pops when the final mission ends.
tips: The cited guide lists the Kitty Litter Lab locations Tyrone's strand needs.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.desc: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Bret asks you to hunt a unique animal. Take a rifle, follow the hunting prompts, and take the shot when the animal is in range — a clean kill from distance beats a chase through the brush. The trophy pops once the hunt is done.
tips: Bring a scoped rifle and approach downwind; spooked prey runs far.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.desc: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete any 8 stranger mission strands across Leonida. The six named strangers in this phase — Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone and Bret — plus two more strands you will meet while exploring, are more than enough. Finish each strand's final mission; the counter ticks up per completed strand, and the silver pops at eight.
tips: Stranger icons appear on the map as the story advances — clear them between chapters so none is left for the endgame.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck

goal.note: 18 sets exist; 15 are needed for 100% completion

trophies.guide: Collect every card in any 3 of the 18 Collectible Card sets scattered across Leonida. Track your sets under Touch Pad > Progress > Collections > Collectible Cards. Cards you have collected can be sold at pawn shops and still count toward your progress, so do not be afraid to sell duplicates. You need 15 sets for 100% completion, so this silver pops early on the road to A Long Road.
tips: Use a card-location guide and clear one set per area as you explore, rather than backtracking later.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Hold Up to open the WAiNK app on Jason or Lucia's phone and scan scannable spots: 31 landmarks, 35 curiosities, 23 sculptures, plus No Flusher tags — 100 scans in total. Point the phone at a scannable object until it registers, then move on. Track progress under Touch Pad > Progress > Collections > WAiNK Locations.
tips: Scan everything you pass while doing other phases — the 100 adds up without a dedicated grind.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.desc: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 meditation spots across Leonida. A meditation only counts once the final 'zen' animation has played, so stay until it finishes. This is the one trophy guide sites flag as possibly missable: one spot is at Jason's house in Chapter 1, so do it before the story moves on — that is why this guide puts it in Phase 1's tips too. Find discovered spots on the map under Touch Pad > Exploration > Meditate Around Leonida, and track them under Progress > Collections > Exploration > Meditations.
tips: Do the Jason's-house meditation in Chapter 1. Do not leave it for the endgame.
Wait for the full zen animation — leaving early does not count.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 different vehicles — you discover one by getting inside it or by scanning it. This happens naturally through the story, since you will drive, steal and scan dozens of cars, bikes, boats and planes along the way. Check what you have found under Touch Pad > Progress > Vehicles, and mop up the last few in busy areas like Vice City traffic.
tips: Scan every new vehicle you pass instead of only driving them — scanning counts as discovering.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Visit every region of Leonida until the whole map is revealed. Drive the highways, fly over the swamps, sail the coastline — the map fills in as you travel. It pairs naturally with the collectible sweep: as you hunt cards, WAiNK spots and meditation sites, the map reveals itself, and this pops when the last corner is uncovered.
tips: Take a plane for the far corners — flying reveals map faster than driving.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.chapter: Vice City Real Estate app: 8 garages
trophies.guide: Buy all 8 one-slot garages through the Vice City Real Estate app on your phone: Mitchel Auto Center $4,000, 7th Avenue Garage $12,000, Vela Rota Drive Garage $24,000, Persistence Road Garage $7,600, Wyatt Motors $21,600, Bonita Court Garage $34,000, Atlantic Court Garage $40,000, and Store n' Bolt $16,800 — $160,000 in all. Garages let you store registered vehicles, so they also feed the On the Spot trophy.
tips: Buy the cheap garages first for storage space; save the $40,000 Atlantic Court one for last.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.desc: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 different vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Drive any vehicle into a Pay 'N' Spray or Mod Shop and register it there; Scooter Bros will then deliver it, fully repaired, to your location for a small fee. You need a free parking spot for each registration, so buy garages first if you are full.
tips: Register cheap, common cars first — the trophy counts vehicles, not value.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.desc: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder Marked Bills through your contacts until the total reaches $250,000. The total accumulates across the whole game, so keep laundering whenever you pick up marked bills instead of letting them pile up. It is a slow burn, not a single job — check your laundered total in the progress menu as you go.
tips: Launder early and often; the $250,000 target is cumulative.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops — clothes, food, anything counts. Find shops on the map under Touch Pad > Style. It adds up quickly if you buy outfits, snacks and gear as you play instead of hoarding cash, and by the time you have bought the garages for Little Boxes you will be most of the way there.
tips: The easiest $100,000 in the game: just shop normally and it pops on its own.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Attain 100% completion. You do not need literally everything — 15 of the 18 card sets and 70 of the 80 challenges count toward it — but it is still the longest grind in the game, and the hardest trophy by most accounts. The in-game checklist appears after the story under Touch Pad > Progress > 100% Completion. Treat it as the last trophy: finish the story, work the other phases, then let the checklist tell you what is left.
tips: Check the 100% list after the story — it is the only reliable map of what remains.
Expect 200+ hours for the platinum; most of it is this trophy.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete any 250 of the 397 stunts in Leonida: stunt jumps (130), under the bridges (202), knife flights (40) and base jumps (25). You need a little over half of them, so skip the hardest and take the easy ones first. Find stunt spots on the map under Touch Pad > Exploration > Stunt Spots, and track them under Progress > Activities > Stunts.
tips: Under-the-bridge stunts are the most numerous — a fast plane clears dozens quickly.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.desc: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the nine activity types at least once — races, shooting ranges, fishing, arcade games, drone races and the rest. One try each is enough; you do not need to win or finish. It is best done early, while you are exploring, since a single attempt at each activity also unlocks the deeper trophies tied to them.
tips: Do this in Phase 1's downtime — one try per activity, then move on.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.desc: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges, across the two ranges: Rodgers Ranch & Shooting Range in Port Gellhorn and Griffin Shooting Range in Balsero. Find them on the map under Touch Pad > Activities > Shooting Ranges. Most challenges have three difficulty tiers to clear for gold, and some are locked until you meet other conditions shown on the map. Track progress under Activities > Shooting Ranges.
tips: Clear the easy tiers first to learn each challenge, then push for gold.
Some challenges only unlock after other conditions — check the map for what gates them.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.desc: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at all 14 locations. Some locations charge an entry fee, so bring cash. Find every location under Touch Pad > Activities > Drones > Top Fun Drones, and take them one at a time — drone handling is its own skill, and the early races teach it.
tips: Learn the drone controls on the first race before chasing wins at all 14.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races — winning the same race repeatedly does not count. Track them all under Touch Pad > Activities > Racing. Most race locations let you hire a car; pay attention to its Rating, which you can improve with upgrades from Mod Shops. Pick short, easy races first and bank the wins.
tips: 20 different races — vary the locations, and upgrade the car you race in.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.desc: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Fairly early in the game, Cal asks you to catch a Parrotfish over 2kg. Take a boat with a fishing rod to the marked area and fish until you land one of that size — the game shows the weight, so release the small ones and keep casting. The trophy pops when you beat Cal's challenge.
tips: You need a boat with a rod — hijack one in the area if you do not own one.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete any arcade game. Arcades are marked on the map — walk in, pick the shortest game on offer, and play it to the end. It is one of the quickest trophies in the game, and a good palate cleanser between the long grinds.
tips: Pick the shortest arcade game you can find.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete any 50 of the 80 in-game challenges — skill-based feats the game tracks for you. View them all under Touch Pad > Progress > Challenges and pick the easy ones first. You need 70 for 100% completion, so this bronze pops on the way to A Long Road; do not grind it in isolation.
tips: Chase the easy challenges first; the count climbs while you do everything else.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.desc: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Build a 4-star wanted level while your partner is with you, then lose the cops and escape the heat together. Cause chaos in a quiet area so you control the buildup, then break line of sight — tunnels, the water, or a fast car out of the search zone — and stay hidden until the stars clear.
tips: Do it with your partner present — solo escapes do not count.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.desc: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.chapter: 3 shops in a row, with your partner
trophies.guide: With your partner alongside, rob three shops back-to-back without losing your wanted level between them. Pick three shops close together, hit them in quick succession, and keep moving — the trick is speed, not firepower. If the wanted level drops between robberies, the chain breaks and you start over.
tips: Plan a route with three nearby shops before you start.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.desc: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Pick a shootout with clustered enemies — a mission firefight or a gang hideout — trigger Combat Focus with five or more in front of you, and drop them before it ends. A rifle with a large magazine helps; do not waste the focus on one or two targets.
tips: Wait for a clustered group before triggering Combat Focus.

trophies.name: Catch Me if You Can
trophies.desc: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at Vice City International Airport: get into a plane on the tarmac and take off without clearance. Expect the airport to respond — get airborne fast and climb, and the trophy pops once you are away.
tips: Pick a plane near a runway end so the takeoff is short.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Get into a Rhino tank. The description is the hint — find a Rhino, climb in, and the trophy pops. Expect a heavy police response the moment you do, so have an exit in mind before you take it for a spin.
tips: Rhinos attract maximum attention — enjoy the ride, then ditch it fast.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.desc: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Go in quiet — avoid the cameras and the guards, take the goods, and leave before anyone raises the alarm. A stealthy approach beats a loud one here: if you are spotted, the attempt fails and you try again.
tips: Case the store first; note the cameras before you go in.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape each time. Plan the getaway before you go in — a fast vehicle parked nearby and a route out of the search zone matter more than the robbery itself. Each vault counts once you escape cleanly, so five careful jobs beat five rushed ones.
tips: Park the getaway car before the robbery, not after.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.desc: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. Intercept one on the road, stop it, crack it open and grab the cash, then lose the heat. Trucks follow routes, so watch one first to learn its path, then pick a quiet stretch for the hit.
tips: Hit the truck on a quiet stretch of road, away from police stations.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.desc: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an illegal operation belonging to each gang in Leonida. Each gang runs its own operations, marked once discovered — hit one per gang and the trophy pops. Work through them methodically, gang by gang, rather than hitting the same gang's spots twice.
tips: Track which gangs you have hit — one operation per gang is the requirement.

trophies.name: In the Beginning...
trophies.desc: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Go to a bar with a view on Ocean Beach, order a cocktail and enjoy it. It is one of the easiest trophies in the game — no skill, no grind, just a drink with a view. Do it whenever you are passing Ocean Beach.
tips: The easiest trophy in the game — a cocktail on Ocean Beach.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.desc: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Drive a car straight out through a vehicle showroom's glass, in classic style. Pick a showroom, build speed inside or on the approach, and smash through the front. The trophy pops on the exit — expect a wanted level and a bill for the glass.
tips: Use a fast, heavy car and aim for the biggest window.

trophies.name: Let's Go Bowling
trophies.desc: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Go to the Kolt & Associates bowling alley and follow through on a bowl. A full game is not required — the follow-through is what counts. It is a quick, fun trophy to grab between the long grinds.
tips: One bowl with a proper follow-through is enough.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: Max out strength with both Jason and Lucia. Build strength through gyms and physical activities, switching between the two protagonists so both progress. The trophy pops once both are maxed — it is a slow burn, so fold gym visits into your routine rather than grinding it in one sitting.
tips: Alternate protagonists so both gain strength; gyms are the fastest route.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: This one pops from a story decision — choices made, for better or worse. Guide sites still list its exact trigger as unconfirmed, so the honest advice is to keep playing the story: it unlocks as the narrative branches, and no special preparation is needed. Check the cited guides for the latest confirmed method if it has not popped by the finale.
tips: Method still being confirmed by guide sites — it pops during normal story play.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Second time's the charm — this pops on a retry, after a first attempt fails. Guide sites still list its exact trigger as unconfirmed, so the honest advice is to keep playing: it comes naturally when something fails once and you succeed the second time. Check the cited guides for the latest confirmed method.
tips: Method still being confirmed by guide sites — it pops during normal play.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: A secret-encounter trophy — the description is the reaction it wants. Guide sites still list its method as unconfirmed, so the honest advice is to explore Leonida's odd corners and check the cited guides for the latest confirmed method rather than chasing a rumour. It pops from a strange event in the world, not from the story.
tips: Method still being confirmed by guide sites — check the cited guide for updates.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.desc: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl enemies over with a melee drive-by — drive or ride past a group and swing a melee weapon from the vehicle. Guide sites list the precise method as still being confirmed, so the honest advice is to try it on a group of enemies from a slow-moving bike or car, and check the cited guides for the latest confirmed method.
tips: Method still being confirmed by guide sites — a melee swing from a moving vehicle is the shape of it.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: Earn every other trophy. The campaign ends here: finish the story, clear the stranger strands, sweep the collectibles, grind the long road — and the platinum pops. Roughly 200 to 300 hours by most estimates, and the last trophy is usually A Long Road, the 100% completion gold.
tips: The last trophy is usually A Long Road — finish the checklist and the platinum follows.
